title: [ONC] Hematology Oncology Commerical Lead
description:
The Oncology team is looking for a Commercial Director who will lead the commercial organization of Marketing and the customer-facing SME organization (HSP) for our growing Hematology Portfolio – Elrexfio and Besponsa. Elrexfio is expected to hit ~$100m in annual sales in 2025 and will be one of Pfizer Japan’s Top Priority Brands in OP26. Besponsa is indicated for Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL) which is a cancer with a high unmet need. Besponsa is a smaller product of great reputational importance given the high unmet need it serves. Besponsa received approval for pediatric ALL in March 2024. This leadership role will be responsible for delivering ~$120m revenue target in 2026OP. The Director will manage an organization of ~15-17 people including ~6 Marketers and 1 HSP Customer Facing Team of 8-10, requiring seasoned leadership experience and people management skills. Specifically to lead customer facing team, the Director will set effective KPIs to assess HSP’s performance and guide the execution in the field.  

Elrexfio is the largest growth driver for Oncology and one of Pfizer Japan’s largest growth drivers with the potential to be one of Japan’s largest products by 2030. This role will require a strategic thinking commercial leader who can lead the brand to continued growth on the back of several label expanding indication launches in a highly competitive market with major multinational competitors in Jannsen and GSK. The Director will develop the strategic plans to maximize Elrexfio’s market leadership.  

Besponsa: The Director will be expected to maximize growth and poatinet impact with this smaller but very important product. He/she will be asked to leverage our existing Hematology capabilities and explore additional opportunities to expand our Hematology presence as we aspire to become the Premier Oncology Company in Japan.

The Director will effectively activate a newly created customer facing HSP team to deliver the scientific value expected in a highly complex Heme-Onc therapeutic area.

As a member of the Japan Oncology Leadership Team, the Commercial Lead will be responsible for leading strategic brand planning, Elrexfio life cycle management, omnichannel strategy, and execution of operational plans to meet customer needs, optimize patient outcomes, and deliver on Oncology commercial goals. The Commercial Lead will lead a high-performing, engaged, and innovative team, championing their continued growth and development and committing to successfully embracing the Co-lab model.

1. Strategic Planning and Execution: Lead all aspects of strategic brand planning and commercial management, delivering strategies and executing tactics to achieve financial budget (revenue and IBT in Operating Plan) for the portfolio

2. Strategic Prioritization : Make trade-off decisions to prioritize focus areas and spend investment to maximize brand and launch performance

3. Organizational Leadership: Lead, mentor, and manage a team of marketing talents and customer-facing colleagues, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence

3. Executional leadership of Customer Facing Team: Mobilize customer facing team (HSP) with clear KPI and execution guidance (e.g. allocation, segmentation & targeting)  to ensure impactful execution in the field  

4. Omni-channel strategy : Lead the development and execution of Brand Plans, including developing robust omnichannel strategies and content to meet customer needs, optimize patient outcomes and maximise brand opportunities and values.

5. Shaping external market landscape : Proactively shape the market for new launches and navigate the external uncertainty

6. Cross functional leadership: Partner and collaborate with relevant Global & ICO teams and locally with sales, P&HE, ISE and cross functional to deliver the outcomes 

7. Financial accountability: Partner with Finance to develop business forecasts and regularly track performance against budget targets

8. Integrity: Partner with medical affairs, regulatory, legal and compliance to ensure strict adherence to promotional guidelines and 100% compliance with all law, regulation, SOP, internal or external rule/policies.

Behavioral Skills 

Understanding and demonstration of all actionable attitudes
Strong enthusiastic leadership and ownership mindset to drive the business.
Robust logical thinking capability for analyzing data and information, and for communicating with senior management in a well-organized way.
 Strong problem-solving capability demonstrated in the ability to connect the dots (understand interdependency) and to prioritize data and information.
Strong ability to be insightful, innovative, entrepreneurial, and collaborative.
Track-record of active contribution to create and operate in an environment that continuously embraces and encourages the implementation of innovative ideas
Deep customer insight informs idea creation and innovative marketing strategy
Demonstrated ability of working with and influence on multiple internal stakeholders and functions, including global, cross functional and other BU colleagues.
Demonstrated ability to develop KOL and external stakeholder relationships and networks
Ability to develop future Pfizer leaders by coaching, as well as outstanding human-relationship capability for team building is required.
Proven collaboration skills to effectively influence, guide, coach peers and other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create positive business impact

Technical Skills 

Strong competency in commercial strategy and execution
Excellent financial acumen in addition IT literacy for forecasting and business case development.
Knowledge of pharmaceutical and healthcare industry and external environment.
Strong track record of compliance, integrity
Excellent presentation skill, communication skill, coaching skills and English skills
Strong project and process management skills, along with the ability to work on multiple tasks and to prioritize effectively

Experience 

Extensive experience developing and implementing pharmaceutical business strategy.
Experiences in building high performing team that includes Customer Facing team
Experience in leading and developing talents to achieve the aspirational goals
Experience in developing and implementing omnichannel marketing strategy
Proven track record of leading projects, driving changes, and organizing teams that successfully achieve milestones and deliverables.
Experience working in multiple cultures and demonstrated ability to work effectively across cultures.

description:
Japan Study Managerは、日本国内において治験の管理・監督を担い、CROや治験実施医療機関と連携しながら、治験参加者の安全と福祉、治験の品質を確保し、治験の計画通りの実施をリードします。グローバル・ローカル双方と連携し、課題解決や進捗管理も担当します。

JOB SUMMARY & RESPONSIBILITIES 

Responsible for in country study/site management and clinical/scientific oversight activities of assigned clinical trials to ensure patient safety and quality study execution in accordance with applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices (GCP), and Pfizer standards.
Provides quality oversight to the CRO and of the CRO deliverables related to study execution. Leads and coordinates the execution of a clinical trial from study start-up through database release and inspection readiness to ensure timely delivery of quality study data. Provides leadership to the teams in the setting of realistic recruitment targets and delivery milestones as the single point of accountability for detailed study start-up and monitoring plans and for delivery to the agreed plans.
Act as core member of the Study Team and will represent the CRO on matters of study execution.
Accountable for managing investigator site relationships to ensure effective delivery of clinical trials (e.g., study start up, enrollment, database release), to safeguard the quality of investigator sites (e.g., site health, patient safety) and to maintain investigator and study coordinator engagement and satisfaction.
Acts as local expert for the assigned clinical trials and brings that expertise to support the investigator site, which includes the investigator, study coordinator, pharmacist etc, and to oversee and support the site monitor in the conduct of clinical trials. This role is responsible for the resolution of protocol-related issues at the local level.
Ensure timely communication with bidirectionally between global and local study team.

Training and Education Preferred:

Study management and site management experience
Working knowledge of GCPs, monitoring, clinical and regulatory operations ​
BS – minimum of 4 years relevant experience
MS/PhD – minimum of 2 years relevant experience
Language:

Excellent writing and communication skills in both Japanese and English is required.

title: [R&D] Japan Clinical Leader
description:
1. Objectives

Responsible for clinical development of the assigned project in Japan under the supervision of the Japan Development Leader (JDL), who assumes responsibility for development of all projects in Japan in the respective therapeutic/disease area (TA/DA). Exercises proactive leadership in the project and obtains approval in Japan. Works with the Global Clinical Leader (GCL) and Clinicians to formulate and execute the global and Japan development strategies of the project. 

2. Roles and Responsibilities

Evaluate candidates for development in the assigned TA/DA from scientific and technical aspects and formulate an effective development plan for Japan with the JDL and the global team. Contribute to establishing the global development plan by discussing points to consider in developing the product (including biomarkers and diagnostics) and obtaining approval in Japan (e.g. medical practice, communication with the government) with the global team and considering strategies towards early launch. 
Establish good working relationships with internal and external stakeholders [e.g. key opinion leaders (KOL), academic society, patient group] to enhance the possibility of expedited development and early approval with the JDL and senior JCL. 
Lead Japan Development Team (JDT) and clinical studies of assigned project to success in cooperation with JDT and global team members. 
Communicate closely with the GCL and Clinicians in Worldwide Research and Development (WRD) and respective Business Units (BU) and build and execute an effective development strategy. 
Prepare high quality documents (e.g.study outline, briefing document, CTD, query response, publications) and review them. 
When a Clinical Scientist (CS) is assigned to the project, review the documents prepared by the CS (e.g. full protocol, informed consent document, investigator's brochure); when a CS is not assigned, the JCL is responsible to prepare and review these documents. 
Contribute to the preparation of the risk management plan for J-NDA submission and other documents required after approval. 
Review clinical data and protocol deviations and determine necessary actions for clinical studies in which he/she is the Clinical Lead. Review individual subject and cumulative safety data based on the safety review plan. 
Lead preparation of procedures related to independent data monitoring committee (IDMC), adjudication committee (AC), and safety review committee, and manage and execute the committees. 
Continuously seek opportunities for improvement in daily work and propose and implement actions without being ruled by conventional work habits. 

3. Skills and Behavior Requirements

Training & Education Preferred:

Scientific background in education, >3 years or more experience in clinical development
Experience in clinical development; thorough understanding of the processes associated with clinical and regulatory submissions
Skill to design and execute development strategies (e.g. advanced medical and pharmaceutical knowledge, skill to design development strategies, knowledge on clinical study operations including guidelines and SOPs, skill to think logically, innovatively, and flexibly, writing skills)
Leadership skills 
Team building skills, networking skills
Negotiation skills, consensus building skills
Problem solving skills
Project management skills
Excellent writing and communication skills in both Japanese and English
Presentation skills, logical and scientific expertise to discuss with internal/external and Japanese/global stakeholders
Prior Experience Preferred:

Sustained delivery and innovation within the discipline
Sustained contribution to the pharmaceutical R&D process at the study level
Proven ability to contribute to multiple projects
Successful management of medium-sized teams consisted by multiple functions

Work Location Assignment:Hybrid
